string search(string word, string[] board)
    dr := [0, 1, 1, 1, 0, -1, -1, -1]
    dc := [1, 1, 0, -1, -1, -1, 0, 1]
    directions := ["E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW", "N", "NE"]
    for: r < 10
        for: c < 10
            for: direction < 8
                for: k < int(#word)
                    row := r + k * dr[direction]
                    column := c + k * dc[direction]
                    if row < 0 or row >= 10 or column < 0 or column >= 10 or board[row][column] != word[k]
for word := words[]
    println("{word}: {search(word, board)}")
